item.text: The loader currently always calls `ReadInConfig`, so an empty path fails before defaults are applied. It already derives dotted key bindings from struct tags; I’m checking how Viper binds nested keys so the empty-path fix preserves the existing file behavior and env precedence.

With an empty path, the loader will now reach its existing defaulters and env binding/unmarshal flow. I’ll add a focused test covering defaults, both requested env overrides, and env precedence over a config file, then run the config package tests.
The config package test run is still compiling/running and has not produced output yet. I’m waiting for its result before closing this out.
